(stringTrim line) \"(:c \")\n       (and (some? (areaOf line)) (some? (doOf line)))))\n\nfn commitArea line: String -> String\n  (optionOr (areaOf line) \"\")\n\nfn commitDo line: String -> String\n  (optionOr (doOf line) \"\")\n\nfn areasOf lines: (List String) -> (List String)\n  (fold (fn [acc line]\n          (if (isCommit line)\n            (let [(a (commitArea line))]\n              (if (listContains? acc a) acc (listAppend acc (cons a (listEmpty? acc)))))\n            acc))\n        (listEmpty? lines)\n        lines)\n\nfn notesOf lines: (List String) -> String\n  (let [(areas (areasOf lines))]\n    (stringJoin\n      (map (fn [a]\n             (stringJoin\n               (cons (stringConcat \"## \" a)\n                     (map (fn [line] (stringConcat \"- \" (commitDo line)))\n                          (filter (fn [line] (and (isCommit line) (stringContains? (stringConcat \" :a \" (stringConcat a \" \")) line)))\n                                  lines)))\n               \"\\n\"))\n           areas)\n      \"\\n\"))\n```\n(:step :op \"write\" :file \"tools/tests/releaseNotesTest.asl\" :content :raw)\n```\n(module tools/tests/releaseNotesTest\n  :x [runTests]\n  :i [(tools/releaseNotes :n notesOf)])\n\nfn runTests -> Bool\n  (let [(lines (listAppend (listAppend (listAppend (listEmpty? lines)\n        (cons \"(:c :a core :do add thing)\" (listEmpty? lines)))\n        (cons \"garbage line\" (listEmpty? lines)))\n        (cons \"(:c :a ui :do paint)\" (listEmpty? lines))))]\n    (let [(out (notesOf lines))]\n      (and (assert (stringContains? out \"## core\") \"core header\")\n           (and (assert (stringContains? out \"- add thing\") \"core item\")\n                (and (assert (stringContains? out \"## ui\") \"ui header\")\n                     (assert (stringContains? out \"- paint\") \"ui item\"))))))\n```\n(:step :op \"gate\")"})
